name: Payload CMS Container Fallback Origin Rules
description: Routes Payload CMS v3 /admin and /api/payload endpoints to containerized Node.js origin while maintaining Next.js storefront on Cloudflare Workers edge isolates with zero storefront impact.

rules.description: Route Payload CMS Admin UI and Internal APIs to Fly.io Node.js Container Origin
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/admin" or http.request.uri.path starts_with "/admin/" or http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/payload/" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/graphql") and (http.host eq "chrishop.jacobmiller22.com" or http.host eq "staging-chrishop.jacobmiller22.com")
